experiment_name: Meno-J Experiment 10: Calibration Onboarding and Compatibility Bridge

working_theory_updates.claim: Limited labeled personal calibration can improve cohort-level cold-start coverage without retraining the classifier.
Twelve personal calibration windows provide an informative repair for S2 and S4.
working_theory_updates.interpretation: Personal thresholds cover these subjects mainly by expressing much more ambiguity; calibration does not repair the weak underlying classifier representation.

working_theory_updates.claim: Unlabeled standardized centroid distance is sufficient to select compatible external calibration subjects.
working_theory_updates.interpretation: Centroid distance contains a weak association with calibration loss, but nearest-pair selection traded coverage for smaller sets and did not meet the decision rule.

working_theory_updates.claim: A finite conformal threshold is equivalent to useful calibration readiness.
working_theory_updates.interpretation: Nine observations make the alpha=0.1 threshold finite, but the threshold remains an extreme order statistic and can still produce conservative, low-information sets.

revised_j_jump_candidate.name: Calibration readiness frontier
revised_j_jump_candidate.statement: A new subject becomes supportable through distinct stages—no finite personal threshold, finite but extreme threshold, informative personal threshold, and stable personalized threshold—rather than through a single binary onboarding boundary.
revised_j_jump_candidate.next_falsification: Extend the personal calibration curve through the order-statistic transition beyond 18 examples and test whether informativeness improves without classifier retraining; separately test representation or sensor-quality interventions for subjects that remain ambiguous.

guardrails: S2 and S4 are post-Experiment-9 exploratory cases.
The experiment used one dataset and one fixed LDA representation.
Coverage and full-set frequency must remain jointly reported.
No literature novelty claim has been made.
